introHtml: Gray tools offer a professional, understated look that works well in corporate settings and safety kits. Unlike brighter colors, gray doesn't show dirt or wear as easily, making it a practical choice for everyday use. Whether you need branded multi-tools, flashlights, or pocket knives, gray provides a neutral canvas for your logo using pad printing or laser engraving. Ideal for safety managers and HR directors looking for durable giveaways that employees will actually use.
